hypothesis: Only the early shared-weak study has supplied a second dialogue with a certified activity outlier. Treat a per-action correction that relies on a single training dialogue as unreplicated. Independently register this policy before examining the new early-augmented policy's F1. The previous policy's 60-question later returns, the conv-44 q7 discovery and the two early repair vetoes are known.
policy: Use the initial and final shared-weak censuses as fixed inputs. In each target dialogue exclude every window from that dialogue. Fit the same three verified component heads and raw gate as outlier-initial/final. Refit after excluding each remaining training dialogue in turn, including its zero-credit windows. For each skill at a target span intersect the signed segments between zero and each fitted utility correction including the full remaining-data fit. Select the endpoint farthest from zero. Opposite signs or any zero force a zero logit correction. Require at least two distinct non-target dialogues with verified credit for that action. Keep raw utilities, native 20% mixture, temperature 0.05 and original common draw fixed. No tuned shrinkage or choice of donor after observing returns.
controls: Same population with the new early credit set to zero, unreplicated full fit, original raw gate, within-dialogue rotated credit, swapped template/grouping and undivided credit under the same exclusion scheme. Compute separate native, uniform, prior fixed-time and fixed-action returns. Persist each deletion's prediction and per-action support histories. Verify probability and F1 agree with raw when no action has two credit-bearing dialogues. Use identical held dialogue exclusions for comparisons.
evaluation: Keep the existing 25 later windows including 18 evaluation windows and 161 planned evaluation questions, and all 12 early windows / 123 questions as training diagnostics. Record exposure at each freeze and coverage, matched F1, sampled choices/costs, paired dialogue intervals and fixed-population bounds. No formal test data enter the fits or development comparisons.
